Azalea Cream (Azelaic Acid 20%) – 30g | Topical Treatment for Mild to Moderate Acne (Comedonal Acne)
products.descriptionHtml:
Azalea Cream is a dermatologist-recommended topical treatment formulated with micronized azelaic acid (20%), designed to target the root causes of acne. This prescription-strength formula is effective for the treatment of comedonal acne (acne vulgaris) by helping reduce inflammation, clear clogged pores, and normalize skin cell turnover.

Its lightweight, opaque white cream spreads smoothly on the skin and is suitable for long-term use under medical supervision. Clinical results are typically seen after 4 weeks of consistent application, with optimal improvement over several months.

✔️ Key Benefits

Treats mild to moderate acne (acne vulgaris)

Anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties

Helps reduce comedones (whiteheads & blackheads)

Normalizes skin cell shedding to prevent clogged pores

Dermatologically tested and proven effective with continued use

✔️ Indications

Comedonal acne (Acne vulgaris)

✔️ Active Ingredient (per 1g)

Azelaic Acid (Micronized) – 200 mg (20%)

✔️ Directions for Use

Cleanse the affected area with water or a gentle cleanser and pat dry.

Apply a thin layer of Azalea Cream to the affected skin twice daily (morning and evening).

Rub in gently and wash hands after application.

Clinical improvement is usually observed after about 4 weeks.

For best results, continue use regularly for several months as prescribed.

⚠️ If severe irritation occurs, reduce application to once daily, or temporarily discontinue use until irritation subsides.

⚠️ Warnings & Precautions

For external use only.

Avoid contact with eyes, mouth, and mucous membranes. If contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water.

Mild burning or stinging may occur after application; if symptoms persist, consult a physician.

Do not use if hypersensitive to azelaic acid.

If no improvement is seen after several weeks, consult a healthcare professional.

There is no clinical data for use longer than 1 year.

Storage

Store in a tightly closed container below 30°C (86°F)

Shelf life: 36 months from manufacturing date

✔️ Product Details

Type: Topical cream

Formulation: Opaque white cream

Main Ingredient: Azelaic Acid 20% (micronized)

Volume: 30g

Country of Origin: South Korea

products.title: Taeguk Pharm Minoxidil 5% Gel Roller
products.descriptionHtml:
Taeguk Pharm Minoxidil 5% Gel Roller is a topical scalp treatment containing 5% minoxidil (50 mg/g), formulated for the treatment of male-pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia).

Its gel formulation is designed for direct application to the affected scalp areas, while the roller-style applicator helps make targeted application more convenient.

Key Benefits

Contains 5% Minoxidil

Helps support hair growth in areas affected by male-pattern hair loss

Designed for targeted scalp application

Convenient gel formulation

Roller applicator for controlled application

Korean pharmaceutical product by Taeguk Pharm

Key Ingredient

Minoxidil 5% (50 mg/g) — the active ingredient used to promote hair growth in certain types of hair loss.

How to Use

Make sure the hair and scalp are completely dry.

Apply 0.5–1 g of the gel directly to the affected scalp area.

Use twice daily — morning and evening.

Do not exceed 2 g total per day.

Wash your hands thoroughly after application.

For evening use, apply 2–4 hours before bedtime to allow the product to dry.

The Korean medication information recommends a minimum of 4 months of consistent use to assess the treatment. Hair loss may recur after stopping treatment.

Why the Roller?

The roller applicator is designed to make direct, targeted application to the thinning scalp areas easier. Instead of dispensing the gel over the hands, the applicator allows the product to be distributed directly over the intended scalp area.

Important Information

For external use only.

Intended for adults 18 years and older.

The Korean approved indication is male-pattern hair loss (androgenetic alopecia).

Do not apply to the eyes, mouth, nose, wounds, or irritated/inflamed skin.

Wash hands after application.

Do not use on unexplained or sudden hair loss without medical evaluation.

Stop use and consult a healthcare professional if severe irritation, rash, redness, itching, dizziness, rapid heartbeat, or other concerning symptoms occur.

Keep out of reach of children.

Store in a tightly closed, light-protected container at 1–30°C.

Product Details

Product: Minoxidil Bigroot Gel 5%

Active Ingredient: Minoxidil 5% (50 mg/g)

Product Type: Hair Loss Treatment / Scalp Treatment
